features.feature: Rectangular mattress with gently rounded corners and a low, even profile.
Blue-gray quilted top with repeating staggered rows of raised, elongated rounded rectangles.
Light gray upper side band above a dark gray vertically ribbed side wall; thin pale horizontal piping runs across the lower side, with dark blue edging at the base.
Dark navy, angled-bottom label with a turquoise lower strip attached to the long side panel near the middle.
The side label reads “DUROFLEX”, “DUROPEDIC” and “BACK MAGIC PRO +”.
